en.g: Name everyday food and drinks and say what you like to eat.
p: Basic food: bread, rice, eggs, cheese, chicken, fish.
Fruit and vegetables: apples, bananas, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes.
Drinks: water, juice, milk, tea, coffee; say I like... and I don't like...
en.q: What do you usually have for breakfast?
en.c: Name in English everything you eat and drink today.

de.g: Du lernst alltägliche Lebensmittel und Getränke und sagst, was du gern isst.
p: Grundnahrung: bread, rice, eggs, cheese, chicken, fish.
Obst und Gemüse: apples, bananas, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes.
Getränke: water, juice, milk, tea, coffee; sag I like... und I don't like...
de.q: Was isst du normalerweise zum Frühstück?
de.c: Benenne heute auf Englisch alles, was du isst und trinkst.

es.g: Aprende comidas y bebidas cotidianas y a decir lo que te gusta comer.
p: Comida básica: bread, rice, eggs, cheese, chicken, fish.
Frutas y verduras: apples, bananas, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes.
Bebidas: water, juice, milk, tea, coffee; di I like... e I don't like...
es.c: Nombra hoy en inglés todo lo que comas y bebas.

fr.g: Nommer les aliments et boissons du quotidien et dire ce que tu aimes manger.
p: Aliments de base : bread, rice, eggs, cheese, chicken, fish.
Fruits et légumes : apples, bananas, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes.
Boissons : water, juice, milk, tea, coffee ; dis I like... et I don't like...
fr.c: Nomme en anglais tout ce que tu manges et bois aujourd'hui.

it.g: Impari cibi e bevande di tutti i giorni e a dire cosa ti piace mangiare.
p: Cibi di base: bread, rice, eggs, cheese, chicken, fish.
Frutta e verdura: apples, bananas, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes.
Bevande: water, juice, milk, tea, coffee; di' I like... e I don't like...
it.q: Cosa mangi di solito a colazione?
it.c: Nomina oggi in inglese tutto quello che mangi e bevi.

pt.g: Aprende comidas e bebidas do dia a dia e a dizer o que gostas de comer.
p: Comida básica: bread, rice, eggs, cheese, chicken, fish.
Fruta e legumes: apples, bananas, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes.
Bebidas: water, juice, milk, tea, coffee; diz I like... e I don't like...
pt.q: O que costumas comer ao pequeno-almoço?
pt.c: Diz em inglês o nome de tudo o que comeres e beberes hoje.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda comidas e bebidas do dia a dia e a dizer o que você gosta de comer.
p: Comida básica: bread, rice, eggs, cheese, chicken, fish.
Frutas e legumes: apples, bananas, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes.
Bebidas: water, juice, milk, tea, coffee; diga I like... e I don't like...
pt_BR.q: O que você costuma comer no café da manhã?
pt_BR.c: Diga em inglês o nome de tudo o que você comer e beber hoje.

vocab.ex: I have bread and butter for breakfast.
We eat rice and beans.
She likes eggs in the morning.
Vegetables are good for you.
I eat fruit every day.
Can I have orange juice?

target.gram: I like + noun: I like fish. I don't like + noun: I don't like milk. Plural for countable food: apples.

en.g: Order food and drinks politely in a café.
p: Order with Can I have a coffee, please? or I'd like a sandwich, please.
I'd like means I would like; it sounds polite and friendly.
The staff may ask Anything else? or To have here or to take away?
en.q: What would you order right now in your favourite café? Say it politely.
en.c: Practise ordering your favourite drink and snack aloud, twice, in English.

de.g: Du lernst, im Café höflich Essen und Getränke zu bestellen.
p: Bestell mit Can I have a coffee, please? oder I'd like a sandwich, please.
I'd like bedeutet I would like und klingt höflich und freundlich.
Das Personal fragt vielleicht Anything else? oder To have here or to take away?
de.q: Was würdest du jetzt in deinem Lieblingscafé bestellen? Sag es höflich.
de.c: Übe zweimal laut auf Englisch, dein Lieblingsgetränk und einen Snack zu bestellen.

es.g: Aprende a pedir comida y bebida con educación en una cafetería.
p: Pide con Can I have a coffee, please? o I'd like a sandwich, please.
I'd like significa I would like y suena educado y amable.
Te pueden preguntar Anything else? o To have here or to take away?
es.q: ¿Qué pedirías ahora en tu cafetería favorita? Dilo con educación.
es.c: Practica dos veces en voz alta cómo pedir tu bebida y tu tentempié favoritos en inglés.

fr.g: Commander poliment à manger et à boire dans un café.
p: Commande avec Can I have a coffee, please? ou I'd like a sandwich, please.
I'd like veut dire I would like ; c'est poli et chaleureux.
On peut te demander Anything else? ou To have here or to take away?
fr.q: Que commanderais-tu maintenant dans ton café préféré ? Dis-le poliment.
fr.c: Entraîne-toi deux fois à voix haute à commander ta boisson et ton en-cas préférés en anglais.

it.g: Impari a ordinare con gentilezza cibo e bevande al bar.
p: Ordina con Can I have a coffee, please? o I'd like a sandwich, please.
I'd like significa I would like e suona gentile e cordiale.
Il personale può chiedere Anything else? o To have here or to take away?
it.q: Cosa ordineresti adesso nel tuo bar preferito? Dillo con gentilezza.
it.c: Esercitati due volte ad alta voce a ordinare in inglese la tua bevanda e il tuo snack preferiti.

pt.g: Aprende a pedir comida e bebida com educação num café.
p: Pede com Can I have a coffee, please? ou I'd like a sandwich, please.
I'd like quer dizer I would like e soa educado e simpático.
Podem perguntar Anything else? ou To have here or to take away?
pt.q: O que pedirias agora no teu café preferido? Di-lo com educação.
pt.c: Treina duas vezes em voz alta, em inglês, o pedido da tua bebida e do teu lanche preferidos.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a pedir comida e bebida com educação numa cafeteria.
p: Peça com Can I have a coffee, please? ou I'd like a sandwich, please.
I'd like quer dizer I would like e soa educado e simpático.
Podem perguntar Anything else? ou For here or to go?
pt_BR.q: O que você pediria agora na sua cafeteria favorita? Fale com educação.
pt_BR.c: Treine duas vezes em voz alta, em inglês, o pedido da sua bebida e do seu lanche favoritos.

vocab.ex: Can I have a tea, please?
I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.
A cup of coffee, please.
Anything else? No, thank you.
A latte to take away, please.
Can I see the menu, please?

target.gram: Polite orders: Can I have + item, please? / I'd like (= I would like) + item, please.

en.g: Tell apart nouns you can count from nouns you cannot.
p: Countable nouns have a plural and take a or an: an apple, two apples.
Uncountable nouns have no plural and no a: water, rice, milk, bread, money.
Use some with uncountables: some water, some rice, a glass of water.
en.q: Look at your kitchen: name two countable and two uncountable things.
en.c: Sort ten food words into two lists today: countable and uncountable.

de.g: Du lernst, zählbare von unzählbaren Nomen zu unterscheiden.
p: Zählbare Nomen haben einen Plural und a oder an: an apple, two apples.
Unzählbare haben keinen Plural und kein a: water, rice, milk, bread, money.
Bei Unzählbaren nimmst du some: some water, some rice, a glass of water.
de.q: Schau in deine Küche: Nenn zwei zählbare und zwei unzählbare Dinge.
de.c: Sortier heute zehn Lebensmittel in zwei Listen: zählbar und unzählbar.

es.g: Aprende a distinguir los sustantivos que se cuentan de los que no.
p: Los contables tienen plural y llevan a o an: an apple, two apples.
Los incontables no tienen plural ni a: water, rice, milk, bread, money.
Con los incontables usa some: some water, some rice, a glass of water.
es.q: Mira tu cocina: nombra dos cosas contables y dos incontables.
es.c: Clasifica hoy diez alimentos en dos listas: contables e incontables.

fr.g: Distinguer les noms qu'on peut compter de ceux qu'on ne peut pas compter.
p: Les dénombrables ont un pluriel et prennent a ou an : an apple, two apples.
Les indénombrables n'ont ni pluriel ni a : water, rice, milk, bread, money.
Avec eux, on utilise some : some water, some rice, a glass of water.
fr.q: Regarde ta cuisine : nomme deux choses dénombrables et deux indénombrables.
fr.c: Classe dix aliments en deux listes aujourd'hui : dénombrables et indénombrables.

it.g: Impari a distinguere i nomi che si contano da quelli che non si contano.
p: I numerabili hanno il plurale e vogliono a o an: an apple, two apples.
I non numerabili non hanno plurale né a: water, rice, milk, bread, money.
Con questi si usa some: some water, some rice, a glass of water.
it.q: Guarda la tua cucina: nomina due cose numerabili e due non numerabili.
it.c: Dividi oggi dieci alimenti in due liste: numerabili e non numerabili.

pt.g: Aprende a distinguir os nomes que se contam dos que não se contam.
p: Os contáveis têm plural e levam a ou an: an apple, two apples.
Os incontáveis não têm plural nem a: water, rice, milk, bread, money.
Com incontáveis usa-se some: some water, some rice, a glass of water.
pt.q: Olha para a tua cozinha: diz duas coisas contáveis e duas incontáveis.
pt.c: Separa hoje dez alimentos em duas listas: contáveis e incontáveis.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a diferenciar os substantivos que se contam dos que não se contam.
p: Os contáveis têm plural e levam a ou an: an apple, two apples.
Os incontáveis não têm plural nem a: water, rice, milk, bread, money.
Com incontáveis use some: some water, some rice, a glass of water.
pt_BR.q: Olhe para a sua cozinha: diga duas coisas contáveis e duas incontáveis.
pt_BR.c: Separe hoje dez alimentos em duas listas: contáveis e incontáveis.

vocab.ex: I'd like an apple, please.
Can I have some water?
There's milk in the fridge.
I don't have much money with me.
A glass of water, please.
Can I have a piece of cake?

target.gram: Countable: a banana, three bananas. Uncountable: no a, no -s: some bread, a slice of bread.

en.g: Use some and any correctly in positive sentences, negatives and questions.
p: Use some in positive sentences: I have some eggs.
Use any in negatives and most questions: I don't have any milk. Do you have any sugar?
Use some in offers and requests: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
en.q: What do you have in your fridge right now? Use some and any.
en.c: Write a short shopping list and three sentences with some and any about it.

de.g: Du lernst some und any richtig in bejahten Sätzen, Verneinungen und Fragen.
p: Some steht in bejahten Sätzen: I have some eggs.
Any steht in Verneinungen und den meisten Fragen: I don't have any milk. Do you have any sugar?
Bei Angeboten und Bitten nimmt man some: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
de.q: Was ist gerade in deinem Kühlschrank? Benutze some und any.
de.c: Schreib eine kleine Einkaufsliste und drei Sätze dazu mit some und any.

es.g: Aprende a usar some y any en frases afirmativas, negativas y preguntas.
p: Some en frases afirmativas: I have some eggs.
Any en negativas y en la mayoría de preguntas: I don't have any milk. Do you have any sugar?
Some en ofrecimientos y peticiones: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
es.q: ¿Qué tienes ahora mismo en la nevera? Usa some y any.
es.c: Escribe una lista de la compra corta y tres frases sobre ella con some y any.

fr.g: Employer some et any dans les phrases affirmatives, négatives et interrogatives.
p: Some dans les phrases affirmatives : I have some eggs.
Any dans les négations et la plupart des questions : I don't have any milk. Do you have any sugar?
Some pour proposer ou demander : Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
fr.q: Qu'y a-t-il dans ton frigo en ce moment ? Utilise some et any.
fr.c: Écris une petite liste de courses et trois phrases à son sujet avec some et any.

it.g: Impari a usare some e any in frasi affermative, negative e domande.
p: Some nelle frasi affermative: I have some eggs.
Any nelle negative e in quasi tutte le domande: I don't have any milk. Do you have any sugar?
Some nelle offerte e richieste: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
it.q: Cosa c'è adesso nel tuo frigo? Usa some e any.
it.c: Scrivi una breve lista della spesa e tre frasi su di essa con some e any.

pt.g: Aprende a usar some e any em frases afirmativas, negativas e perguntas.
p: Some em frases afirmativas: I have some eggs.
Any em negativas e na maioria das perguntas: I don't have any milk. Do you have any sugar?
Some em ofertas e pedidos: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
pt.q: O que tens agora no frigorífico? Usa some e any.
pt.c: Escreve uma pequena lista de compras e três frases sobre ela com some e any.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a usar some e any em frases afirmativas, negativas e perguntas.
p: Some em frases afirmativas: I have some eggs.
Any em negativas e na maioria das perguntas: I don't have any milk. Do you have any sugar?
Some em ofertas e pedidos: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
pt_BR.q: O que você tem agora na geladeira? Use some e any.
pt_BR.c: Escreva uma pequena lista de compras e três frases sobre ela com some e any.

vocab.ex: I have some apples.
We don't have any bread.
Do you have any sugar?
Would you like some tea?
There's some sugar on the table.
Is there any butter?

target.gram: Some in positive sentences and offers; any in negatives and questions: I don't have any eggs.

en.g: Ask about quantity with how much and how many.
p: Use how many with countable nouns: How many eggs do you need?
Use how much with uncountable nouns: How much water do you drink?
Answer with a lot, a few, a little or a number: Just a few. About two litres.
en.q: How many cups of tea or coffee do you drink a day?
en.c: Ask yourself five how much or how many questions about your day and answer them.

de.g: Du lernst, mit how much und how many nach Mengen zu fragen.
p: How many bei zählbaren Nomen: How many eggs do you need?
How much bei unzählbaren Nomen: How much water do you drink?
Antworte mit a lot, a few, a little oder einer Zahl: Just a few. About two litres.
de.q: Wie viele Tassen Tee oder Kaffee trinkst du am Tag?
de.c: Stell dir fünf Fragen mit how much oder how many über deinen Tag und beantworte sie.

es.g: Aprende a preguntar por cantidades con how much y how many.
p: How many con contables: How many eggs do you need?
How much con incontables: How much water do you drink?
Responde con a lot, a few, a little o un número: Just a few. About two litres.
es.q: ¿Cuántas tazas de té o café tomas al día?
es.c: Hazte cinco preguntas con how much o how many sobre tu día y respóndelas.

fr.g: Demander une quantité avec how much et how many.
p: How many avec les dénombrables : How many eggs do you need?
How much avec les indénombrables : How much water do you drink?
Réponds avec a lot, a few, a little ou un nombre : Just a few. About two litres.
fr.q: Combien de tasses de thé ou de café bois-tu par jour ?
fr.c: Pose-toi cinq questions avec how much ou how many sur ta journée et réponds-y.

it.g: Impari a chiedere le quantità con how much e how many.
p: How many con i numerabili: How many eggs do you need?
How much con i non numerabili: How much water do you drink?
Rispondi con a lot, a few, a little o un numero: Just a few. About two litres.
it.q: Quante tazze di tè o caffè bevi al giorno?
it.c: Fatti cinque domande con how much o how many sulla tua giornata e rispondi.

pt.g: Aprende a perguntar quantidades com how much e how many.
p: How many com contáveis: How many eggs do you need?
How much com incontáveis: How much water do you drink?
Responde com a lot, a few, a little ou um número: Just a few. About two litres.
pt.q: Quantas chávenas de chá ou café bebes por dia?
pt.c: Faz a ti mesmo cinco perguntas com how much ou how many sobre o teu dia e responde.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a perguntar quantidades com how much e how many.
p: How many com contáveis: How many eggs do you need?
How much com incontáveis: How much water do you drink?
Responda com a lot, a few, a little ou um número: Just a few. About two liters.
pt_BR.q: Quantas xícaras de chá ou café você toma por dia?
pt_BR.c: Faça para si mesmo cinco perguntas com how much ou how many sobre seu dia e responda.

vocab.ex: How many brothers do you have?
How much milk do you need?
She drinks a lot of water.
I have a few friends here.
Just a little sugar, please.
We need a litre of milk.

target.gram: How many + plural countable (How many apples?); how much + uncountable (How much rice?).

en.g: Name common clothes and ask for help in a clothes shop.
p: Clothes: shirt, T-shirt, jeans, dress, jacket, shoes.
Ask Can I try this on? and Where are the changing rooms?
Talk about size: Do you have this in a medium? It's too small.
en.q: What are you wearing right now? Describe it in English.
en.c: Name every piece of clothing you put on today in English, with its colour.

de.g: Du lernst gängige Kleidungsstücke und fragst im Laden nach Hilfe.
p: Kleidung: shirt, T-shirt, jeans, dress, jacket, shoes.
Frag Can I try this on? und Where are the changing rooms?
Zur Größe: Do you have this in a medium? It's too small.
de.q: Was trägst du gerade? Beschreib es auf Englisch.
de.c: Benenne heute jedes Kleidungsstück, das du anziehst, auf Englisch mit Farbe.

es.g: Aprende prendas comunes y a pedir ayuda en una tienda de ropa.
p: Ropa: shirt, T-shirt, jeans, dress, jacket, shoes.
Pregunta Can I try this on? y Where are the changing rooms?
Habla de tallas: Do you have this in a medium? It's too small.
es.q: ¿Qué llevas puesto ahora mismo? Descríbelo en inglés.
es.c: Nombra hoy en inglés cada prenda que te pongas, con su color.

fr.g: Nommer les vêtements courants et demander de l'aide dans une boutique.
p: Vêtements : shirt, T-shirt, jeans, dress, jacket, shoes.
Demande Can I try this on? et Where are the changing rooms?
Pour la taille : Do you have this in a medium? It's too small.
fr.q: Que portes-tu en ce moment ? Décris-le en anglais.
fr.c: Nomme en anglais chaque vêtement que tu mets aujourd'hui, avec sa couleur.

it.g: Impari i capi d'abbigliamento comuni e a chiedere aiuto in un negozio.
p: Vestiti: shirt, T-shirt, jeans, dress, jacket, shoes.
Chiedi Can I try this on? e Where are the changing rooms?
Per la taglia: Do you have this in a medium? It's too small.
it.q: Cosa indossi in questo momento? Descrivilo in inglese.
it.c: Nomina oggi in inglese ogni capo che indossi, con il suo colore.

pt.g: Aprende peças de roupa comuns e a pedir ajuda numa loja.
p: Roupa: shirt, T-shirt, jeans, dress, jacket, shoes.
Pergunta Can I try this on? e Where are the changing rooms?
Sobre tamanhos: Do you have this in a medium? It's too small.
pt.q: O que tens vestido agora? Descreve em inglês.
pt.c: Diz hoje em inglês o nome de cada peça de roupa que vestires, com a cor.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda peças de roupa comuns e a pedir ajuda numa loja.
p: Roupas: shirt, T-shirt, jeans, dress, jacket, shoes.
Pergunte Can I try this on? e Where are the fitting rooms?
Sobre tamanho: Do you have this in a medium? It's too small.
pt_BR.q: O que você está vestindo agora? Descreva em inglês.
pt_BR.c: Diga hoje em inglês o nome de cada peça de roupa que vestir, com a cor.

vocab.ex: I need a white shirt for work.
These jeans are very comfortable.
Take a jacket, it's cold.
I love your new shoes!
Excuse me, can I try this on?
What size are you? Medium.

target.gram: Too + adjective for a problem: It's too big. Jeans and shoes are always plural: These jeans are new.

en.g: Ask the price, pay and handle receipts and change.
p: Ask How much is it? for one thing and How much are they? for many.
Ask Can I pay by card? or say I'll pay in cash.
Learn receipt (the paper) and change (money you get back): Here's your change.
en.q: How do you usually pay when you go shopping?
en.c: Act out paying for something in English, from How much is it? to Thank you.

de.g: Du lernst, nach dem Preis zu fragen, zu bezahlen und mit Kassenbon und Wechselgeld umzugehen.
p: Frag How much is it? für eine Sache und How much are they? für mehrere.
Frag Can I pay by card? oder sag I'll pay in cash.
Lerne receipt (der Bon) und change (das Wechselgeld): Here's your change.
de.q: Wie bezahlst du normalerweise beim Einkaufen?
de.c: Spiel auf Englisch einen Bezahlvorgang durch, von How much is it? bis Thank you.

es.g: Aprende a preguntar el precio, pagar y manejar el ticket y el cambio.
p: Pregunta How much is it? para una cosa y How much are they? para varias.
Pregunta Can I pay by card? o di I'll pay in cash.
Aprende receipt (el ticket) y change (el cambio): Here's your change.
es.q: ¿Cómo sueles pagar cuando vas de compras?
es.c: Representa en inglés un pago completo, de How much is it? a Thank you.

fr.g: Demander le prix, payer et gérer le ticket et la monnaie.
p: Demande How much is it? pour un article et How much are they? pour plusieurs.
Demande Can I pay by card? ou dis I'll pay in cash.
Retiens receipt (le ticket) et change (la monnaie rendue) : Here's your change.
fr.q: Comment paies-tu d'habitude quand tu fais des achats ?
fr.c: Joue en anglais une scène de paiement, de How much is it? jusqu'à Thank you.

it.g: Impari a chiedere il prezzo, pagare e gestire scontrino e resto.
p: Chiedi How much is it? per una cosa e How much are they? per più cose.
Chiedi Can I pay by card? o di' I'll pay in cash.
Impara receipt (lo scontrino) e change (il resto): Here's your change.
it.q: Come paghi di solito quando fai acquisti?
it.c: Recita in inglese un pagamento, da How much is it? a Thank you.

pt.g: Aprende a perguntar o preço, pagar e lidar com o talão e o troco.
p: Pergunta How much is it? para uma coisa e How much are they? para várias.
Pergunta Can I pay by card? ou diz I'll pay in cash.
Aprende receipt (o talão) e change (o troco): Here's your change.
pt.q: Como costumas pagar quando vais às compras?
pt.c: Encena em inglês um pagamento, desde How much is it? até Thank you.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a perguntar o preço, pagar e lidar com nota fiscal e troco.
p: Pergunte How much is it? para uma coisa e How much are they? para várias.
Pergunte Can I pay by card? ou diga I'll pay in cash.
Aprenda receipt (o comprovante) e change (o troco): Here's your change.
pt_BR.q: Como você costuma pagar quando faz compras?
pt_BR.c: Encene em inglês um pagamento, de How much is it? até Thank you.

vocab.ex: How much is it? It's ten euros.
Can I pay by card?
I'll pay in cash.
Can I have the receipt, please?
Here's your change.
This bag is too expensive.

target.gram: How much is + singular? How much are + plural? Pay by card, pay in cash.

en.g: Describe what exists in a place with there is and there are.
p: There is (there's) for one thing: There's a park near my house.
There are for many things: There are two cafés on my street.
Questions and negatives: Is there a bank? There isn't any milk. There aren't any shops.
en.q: What is there in your street? Tell me three things.
en.c: Describe your street in five sentences with there is and there are.

de.g: Du lernst, mit there is und there are zu beschreiben, was es an einem Ort gibt.
p: There is (there's) für eine Sache: There's a park near my house.
There are für mehrere: There are two cafés on my street.
Fragen und Verneinung: Is there a bank? There isn't any milk. There aren't any shops.
de.q: Was gibt es in deiner Straße? Nenn mir drei Dinge.
de.c: Beschreib deine Straße in fünf Sätzen mit there is und there are.

es.g: Aprende a describir lo que hay en un lugar con there is y there are.
p: There is (there's) para una cosa: There's a park near my house.
There are para varias: There are two cafés on my street.
Preguntas y negativas: Is there a bank? There isn't any milk. There aren't any shops.
es.q: ¿Qué hay en tu calle? Dime tres cosas.

en.t: Prepositions of place: in, on, under
en.g: Say exactly where things are with in, on, under and friends.
p: In is inside something: in the box. On is on a surface: on the table.
Under is below; behind is at the back; in front of is the opposite.
Next to is beside one thing; between is in the middle of two things.
